name: jod-skills
description: Claude Code skills for daily news digests, GitHub trending, open-source status, and codebase audits

plugins.name: jod-skills
plugins.description: All four skills in one install: audit, hn-daily, github-daily, oss-status.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Audit a codebase without reading it line by line. Call graph plus free checkers point at the risky functions, sub-agents read only those, every finding is verified, then it stops and asks you what to fix.

plugins.name: hn-daily
plugins.description: Daily Hacker News digest. Curates the front page down to what is worth your time, reads the comments on the picks, and writes it in plain English.

plugins.name: github-daily
plugins.description: Daily GitHub trending digest. Explains every trending repo in plain English from its README, plus an on-demand deep dive into any one repo.

plugins.name: oss-status
plugins.description: Says what is waiting on you across your open GitHub work. Reads inline review threads, not just the conversation tab, so a buried maintainer question is not missed.
